big_pour.headline: ChatGPT Wallet Lets AI Agents Shop for You
big_pour.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing AI agents to shop and check out on users' behalf. The feature is available in a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

office_blend.headline: K-water Is Using AI to Manage Water Flow
office_blend.summary: Korea Water Resources Corporation, known as K-water, is using AI to transform how it connects the flow of water across dams and purification plants.

office_blend.headline: Natera Built Agentic AI System for Lab Ops
office_blend.summary: Natera built SWARM, an agentic AI system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that captures lab-operations knowledge, delivering about 130x faster first response and 96.2% automated coverage across support tickets.

stories.label: New feature
stories.headline: Gemini 4 Coding Agent Switches Models Mid-Task
stories.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen alongside a system that lets coding agents switch AI models mid-task, completing work 19% faster.

stories.headline: Nvidia Donated OpenShell to Cloud Native Foundation
stories.summary: Nvidia donated OpenShell, its open-source runtime for securing and governing AI agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation.

word.definition: How long a user waits for a response. Time to first token (TTFT) measures how soon the first word of a streamed answer appears.
word.heard: "Total time is fine, but TTFT is three seconds and it feels broken."
word.analogy: Like how long until the barista starts your drink, not just when it's done.
